known_differences.description: fsci-ndimage implements separable Gaussian/uniform filters, HGW min/max filters, median filters, morphology, connected-component labeling, and spline geometric transforms.

threats.description: Boundary reflection / mirror coordinate mapping off-by-one drift during spline geometric interpolation.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-ndimage/src/lib.rs:3239 (gaussian_filter): applies exact SciPy boundary coordinate folding (reflect, mirror, wrap, nearest, constant) across 1D/nD axes.
threats.strict_mode_response: Match SciPy boundary mode coordinate mapping bit-for-bit.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Validate sigma > 0 and finite image values before convolution.

threats.description: Zero-sized filter footprints, negative Gaussian sigma, or shape-mismatched flat image buffers.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-ndimage/src/lib.rs:3160 (uniform_filter): validates positive kernel size, valid image shape product, and finite parameters.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return Err(NdimageError) on invalid filter size or shape mismatch.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject malformed shape or non-finite inputs fail-closed and record FailClosed in AuditLedger.

threats.description: Large 1D/nD sliding window min/max filters degrading to O(N * W) per-window scans without Herk-Gil-Werman prefix/suffix blocks.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-ndimage/src/lib.rs:3679 (median_filter): uses O(1)-amortized Herk-Gil-Werman min/max scans and direct selection for small median footprints.
threats.strict_mode_response: Execute linear-time HGW min/max and bounded median selection.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Validate footprint dimensions and finite image data before allocation.

threats.description: Connected-component labeling (label) union-find equivalence class numbering drifting from canonical raster order.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-ndimage/src/lib.rs:7599 (label): performs two-pass union-find with sequential 1..=num_features relabeling in raster scan order.
threats.strict_mode_response: Emit canonical 1..=num_features component labels matching SciPy ndimage.label.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Validate structuring element dimensions before labeling.

fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Return NdimageError::ShapeMismatch and emit FailClosed audit event.

fail_closed_policies.input_class: non-positive filter size or negative sigma
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Return NdimageError::InvalidParameter and log FailClosed event.

fail_closed_policies.input_class: non-finite image or kernel values in Hardened mode
fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Propagate IEEE NaN per convolution rules.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Reject non-finite inputs fail-closed with NdimageError::NonFiniteInput.
